name: /health sane after sequential run (uptime grew ~ elapsed, connected, 0 waiters)
no memory / fd / thread growth after 50 sequential requests
fix: Investigate leak (cache bounded at 300 msgs, MAX_FETCH=50)

name: 20 register+abandon cycles: waiters released promptly after client RST
observed: active_waiter_count 1s after abandon=20; fully drained 30.3s after start (timeout_s was 30)
fix: Detect client disconnect (await request.is_disconnected() in a watcher task, or anyio cancel scope) and deregister immediately. Leaked waiters keep scanning, can CONSUME OTP emails meant for the retry, and inflate IMAP SEARCH load

name: count returns to 0 eventually (no permanent leak)
no fd/thread leak after abandoned connections
no stale rows left in SQLite waiters table
30 concurrent waits: all 408, no 500, none dropped
30 concurrent finish near their 5s deadline (<=10s)
fix: Deadline not enforced around initial scan(); scans serialize on _scan_lock with one IMAP SEARCH each

name: after burst: waiters 0, IMAP still connected, no growth
observed: waiters settled=0.0s connected=True mem 39.7->41.6MB fds 11->11 threads 4->4

name: deadline honoured as concurrency grows (timeout_s=5): wall/max-elapsed/non-408 per N
fix: Each wait() runs its own scan() under one asyncio lock holding a blocking IMAP round-trip (END IDLE + SEARCH + re-IDLE ~0.9s). Coalesce: one scanner task + per-waiter futures; run waiters' deadlines independently of scan; skip SEARCH when UIDNEXT unchanged

name: journal noise during load (imap error / scan failed / IDLE lines in last 20 min)
Gmail-side amplification: every /v1/wait registration triggers a full IMAP SEARCH (+ DONE/IDLE cycle) with no rate limit
observed: 100 waits issued above => ~100+ SEARCH commands to Gmail in a few minutes
fix: Coalesce scans (min interval 1-2s), serve cache hits without touching IMAP when nothing new (use EXISTS/UIDNEXT from IDLE), rate-limit /v1/wait per client
